title: Susan McCasland's Facebook statement on Roswell bodies and debris at Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: Neil does not have any special knowledge about the ET bodies and debris from the Roswell crash stored at Wright Pad.

plain: In 2026 a woman named Susan McCasland posted a statement on Facebook that, as Michels reads it out, says a man named Neil "does not have any special knowledge about the ET bodies and debris from the Roswell crash stored at Wright Pat." Roswell refers to a reported 1947 crash, and Wright-Patterson is an Air Force base in Ohio. Michels quotes it himself, and the wording seems to take for granted that alien bodies and wreckage are kept there.
